svg.title: viajante, local flight and hotel search
svg.desc: Solari departures board. VIAJANTE wordmark, JFK–NRT sweep quotes in EUR with times and stops, Tokyo stay totals, sweep/detail/MCP lanes. No API keys. Raw card text kept beside every number.
